data: ESA Jupiter flagship — first orbiter ever around a Galilean moon (Ganymede), arrival 2031-2034

Launched 2023-04-14 on an Ariane 5 ECA+ from Kourou on an 8.5-year cruise (Earth-Venus-Earth-Earth gravity-assist trajectory) to a Jupiter arrival in July 2031. Once in the Jovian system, JUICE makes ~35 flybys of Europa, Ganymede, and Callisto before entering Ganymede orbit in 2034 — the first spacecraft ever to orbit a moon other than Earth's. Ten-instrument payload includes ice-penetrating radar (RIME), submillimetre + sub-mm spectrometer, magnetometer, particle spectrometers, and a laser altimeter. Mission goals: characterise Ganymede + Callisto + Europa as potentially habitable subsurface-ocean worlds, probe the Jovian magnetosphere, and constrain Jupiter's atmosphere and gravity field.
Grasset et al. (2013) — JUICE mission profile + science goals (Planetary and Space Science 78)
ESA flagship to Jupiter — first orbiter ever to settle around a Galilean moon (Ganymede, 2034)

Jupiter Icy Moons Explorer. Launched 2023-04-14 on an Ariane 5 ECA+ for an 8.5-year cruise via Earth-Venus-Earth-Earth gravity assists to Jupiter arrival in July 2031. Once in the Jovian system, JUICE flies ~35 times past Europa, Ganymede, and Callisto before entering Ganymede orbit in 2034 — the first spacecraft to orbit a moon other than Earth's. Ten-instrument payload includes ice-penetrating radar (RIME), spectrometers, magnetometer, and a laser altimeter, optimised to characterise the three icy moons as potentially habitable subsurface-ocean worlds.
Largest interplanetary spacecraft built in Europe; first spacecraft ever to orbit a moon of another planet (Ganymede, 2034)
First spacecraft to orbit a comet (67P)
ESA's first Mars orbiter; Europe's first planetary mission
First European Moon mission — solar-electric ion drive. Spiralled to the Moon over 13 months; deliberate impact 2006-09-03
First close-up images of a cometary nucleus — flew 596 km past Halley's Comet at 68 km/s in 1986
First mission to a metal-rich M-class asteroid
